note: Item codes are the .sav column names, unchanged by data/ecuador_2011_safety.do (Table 7 homesec, local survey_cols I51001-I51011). The .sav variable labels (I51001. Alarmas, I51002. Puertas de seguridad, I51003. Colocar rejas en ventanas, I51004. Cercos electricos, I51005. Tener perro guardian, I51006. Guardia de seguridad, I51007. Aumetar seguridad auto, I51008. Seguro contra robo, I51009. Proteccion interna ( cajas s), I51010. Medidas conjuntas, I51011. Otro.........) tie all 11 codes to form q.5.10 options 01-11 by number and content, 11/11. Words are the official Spanish questionnaire p.6, not the terse/typo-bearing .sav labels (Aumetar, truncated cajas s); accents as printed. The shared stem goes in instructions (single section); the double space the justified form prints after 2011, is collapsed; interviewer lines ANOTE EL CODIGO CORRESPONDIENTE PARA CADA OPCION (RM) and the skip SI TODAS LAS RESPUESTAS SON DIFERENTES A 1 PASE A 5.12 not shipped; the Especifique write-in line under Otro not shipped. Resp: .sav value labels Si=1 No=2 No aplica=7 No sabe=8 no responde=9; the do-file recodes Si->1, No->0 and drops 7/8/9. Route 9 by server-side GROUP BY (no export): live item x resp counts equal .sav Si/No counts in 22/22 cells, and the 11 Si counts are mutually distinct. English _translated columns are machine translation by this project.
public_note: The English in the _translated columns is an IRW machine translation of the Spanish INEC questionnaire, and item I51011 is the form write-in Otro (Especifique) catch-all, so its yes responses cover whatever other security measure each respondent named.
